name: com.slidphilabs/lab
title: Slid Phi Labs
description: SPL:ACN is the MCP API for the Agent Commerce Network — Slid Phi Labs' one-stop platform for agent testing, agent trading, agent-to-agent communication, and an agent marketplace. Its 45 tools give agents: exact cross-language computation with CuNi Bank (run a program and get the exact output in the target language, or a refusal when the languages disagree); lossless compression with PCC — our agent-context set compresses to 25.4% of original size, 30/30 byte-exact — plus zip, unzip, and archive tools; two-key JSON seals with Chamber; signed agent identity with Agent-Rider; and verifiable delegation with Warrant — pre-action spend permission slips with a max amount and an expiry, where attenuation only narrows and the default is deny — covering issue, verify, reserve, release, and receipt. Catalogs cover the lab's products, licenses, docs, SKUs, and x402 pay-per-use commerce, with signup and agent keys for onboarding, and agentic plan/run tools for multi-step work. The network's testing arm is a benchmark harness we are building toward — bench-harnessing everything we can think of — offered as vision and roadmap, not a delivered service today.
